notes.title: Bodyrain update v1.4 - Soundtrack update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Hope you've been enjoying Bodyrain! We listened to your feedback and decided to bring these changes to the game:

- Coins, gold bars and coin bags are worth more money
- Added a new soundtrack to the main menu and to the credits
- Fixed a problem where the soundtrack would sound choppy when the game was running on low framerates
- Added more stems to the soundtrack to avoid sounding too repetitive
- Added sounds to the game UI (clicking on bottons, buying and equipping weapons, etc.)

notes.title: Bodyrain update v1.3
notes.content:
Hey guys! Hope you've been enjoying Bodyrain! Here are the changes for this update:

- Fixed a problem where the mouse sensitivity would feel inconsistent, it should be a lot smoother now
- Fixed a bug where the sound/music volume would only apply based on your saved preferences after opening the settings screen
- Added a "report bug" button on the main menu
- Added a button for resetting your save file on the settings menu

notes.title: Bodyrain update v1.2
notes.content:
Hey guys! Hope you've been enjoying Bodyrain! Here are the changes for this update:

- You can now shoot the airdrops, making them fall faster
- Changed the spawn system for the zombies, now they will spawn further away from you
- Added a secret cheat menu (you can access it by pressing the keys C, H, E, A, T at the same time on the main menu
- Fixed a bug on the settings where there would be duplicate values for the same resolution, this happened because the resolutions had different refresh rates. Now the game will show which refresh rate the resolution is
- Added motion blur (optional)
- Optimization changes

Balancing updates:
- Grenade launcher explosion delay: 2 -> 1
- Grenade launcher ammo per box: 12 -> 4
- Grenade launcher damage: 150 -> 160
- Grenade launcher price: 5000 -> 6000
- Grenade launcher starting ammo: 12 -> 4
- Machinegun price: 5000 -> 6000
- Sniper rifle price: 5000 -> 4500
- Sniper rifle magazine capacity: 5 -> 10
- Hunting rifle price: 3000 -> 2000
- Hunting rifle damage: 150 -> 190
- Shotgun price: 2500 -> 2000
- Tactical rifle damage: 30 -> 24
- Assault rifle damage: 29 -> 30
- Assault rifle price: 3000 -> 3500
- SMG price: 800 -> 1000
- SMG damage: 18 -> 22
- SMG accuracy: 96,5% -> 95,8%

notes.title: Bodyrain update v1.1
notes.content:
Hey guys! These are the changes for the latest Bodyrain update:

- Added the functionality to equip your previously equipped weapon by pressing Q
- Added a text to let the players know when an airdrop is being launched
- If there are less than 3 zombies alive and you don't kill anyone for 15 seconds, the next wave will start automatically, preventing a glitch where the game refuses to start the next wave
- Fixed a bug that broke the scoreboard after playing long enough
- Fixed a bug where the flashbang would permanently lower the game volume
- Minor fixes and quality of life changes
